親愛的應屆畢業同學，您們好: 
國立東華大學的畢業典禮即將來臨啦💥，這可是個超重要又值得慶祝的日子🎉活動時間是在2025年5月24日（星期六）下午4點 ， 就是這星期六，各院系早上撥穗，下午為全校性的畢業典禮，我們就在體育館與您共襄盛舉！ 【113學年度畢業典禮】專屬網頁訊息，提供畢業典禮所有相關資訊，歡迎查詢。 活動網址：  http://reurl.cc/4Lr1oK
學務處畢服組 敬邀您一同參與🫶 

Title: 2025 National Dong Hwa University Graduation Ceremony

Dear graduating students, 
     The graduation ceremony at National Dong Hwa University is coming soon💥, and it is a highly honorable and celebratory day! 🎉 The event will take place on Saturday, May 24, 2025, at 4:00 PM, in the Gymnasium. This Saturday morning the professor will turn the tassels for the graduates, and in the afternoon, there will be a university-wide graduation ceremony. We will be celebrating with you in the gymnasium! 
【2025 Graduation Ceremony】Dedicated webpage information, providing all relevant details of the Graduation Ceremony. Feel free to browse. website:  http://reurl.cc/4Lr1oK 
Graduate Placement and Alumni Service Division of Office of Student Affairs invites you to participate together.
